description: Establishment of the Sri Lanka Climate and Nature-Positive Investment Fund
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-03-30 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The National Climate Finance Strategy of Sri Lanka for the period 2025-2030 was launched on 2025-10-24 with the approval of the Cabinet. The need to establish a new integrated framework with a legally-empowered authority to oversee the activities taking place in the Central Highlands, bringing together all relevant parties, has been identified to recover from the catastrophic impact of Cyclone Ditwah. Further, it has also been planned to establish a fund called Climate and Nature Positive Investment Fund - CANOPI Fund to raise funds from domestic and foreign sources for investments that include climate impact mitigation, adaptation and conservation activities. The proposed Fund should be a Statutory Fund established by an Act of Parliament in accordance with the provisions of the Public Finance Management Act No.44 of 2024. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to take further steps pertaining to preparing a Bill to establish the proposed Authority for the restoration of Central Highlands and the Nature-Positive Investment Fund, was approved by the Cabinet.
